- Finding: Fail-honest handling is incomplete. `_file_lines()` returns `None` for both an absent file and a Git read failure, but the main detection path treats an unreadable `p2` side as `continue`, an unreadable base as an empty set, and an unreadable `HEAD` as a deleted file. None of these paths append to `problems`. Consequently, an object-store/read failure can silently omit a real finding or produce an undisclosed/inaccurate comparison, violating AC5b’s requirement that unreadable sides suppress nothing and result in an incomplete-comparison notice or visible SKIP.
- Suggestion: Use `tip_state()` (or a new status-returning reader) for every comparison side used by `dropped_lines`, not only the Filter-1 tip comparison. Distinguish absence from read failure; append a problem on failures and never `continue` merely because a source side could not be read.
